parameters.name: ContactId
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert contact.

*   If you do not specify this parameter, a new alert contact is created.
*   If you specify this parameter, the specified alert contact is modified.

parameters.name: ContactName
parameters.description: The name of the alert contact.

parameters.name: CorpUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the alert contact that is shown to the enterprise when the contact is mentioned with the at sign (@) by a third-party instant messaging (IM) tool.

parameters.name: DingRobotUrl
parameters.description: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description:
The email address of the alert contact.

> You must specify at least one of the **Phone** and **Email** parameters. Each mobile number or email address can be used for only one alert contact.

parameters.name: IsEmailVerify
parameters.description: Specifies whether the email address is verified.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description:
The mobile number of the alert contact.

> You must specify at least one of the **Phone** and **Email** parameters. Each mobile number or email address can be used for only one alert contact.

parameters.name: ReissueSendNotice
parameters.description:
The operation that you want to perform if phone calls fail to be answered. Valid values:

*   0: No operation is performed.
*   1: A phone call is made again.
*   2: A text message is sent.
*   3 (default value): The global default value is used.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-or-update-contact --contact-id 123 --contact-name JohnDoe --phone 13811110000 --email someone@example.com --reissue-send-notice 3 --is-email-verify true --ding-robot-url https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=69d4e0000000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --corp-user-id A123221 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
